custom_fields.dial:
[[[
const temp = Number(
  states['input_number.indoor_temperature']?.state
);

const shown = Number.isFinite(temp)
  ? `${Math.round(temp)}°`
  : '--°';

const mode =
  states['input_select.hvac_mode']?.state || 'Idle';

const accent =
  mode === 'Heating'
    ? '#FFD089'
    : mode === 'Cooling'
      ? '#58B9FF'
      : 'rgba(235,242,248,0.68)';

return `
  <svg viewBox="0 0 80 80"
       style="width:76px;height:76px;display:block;margin:0;">
    <circle
      cx="40"
      cy="40"
      r="30"
      fill="rgba(5,18,31,0.38)"
      stroke="rgba(190,215,235,0.14)"
      stroke-width="5"
    />
    <circle
      cx="40"
      cy="40"
      r="30"
      fill="none"
      stroke="${accent}"
      stroke-width="5"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-dasharray="142 188.5"
      transform="rotate(135 40 40)"
    />
    <text
      x="40"
      y="39"
      text-anchor="middle"
      dominant-baseline="middle"
      fill="white"
      font-size="18"
    >
      ${shown}
    </text>
    <text
      x="40"
      y="54"
      text-anchor="middle"
      fill="${accent}"
      font-size="7.5"
    >
      ${mode}
    </text>
  </svg>
`;
]]]
